result.markdown:
The best payroll software for a small business depends on where your business operates, how many employees you have, and whether you want to handle payroll yourself or have the software take care of taxes and deductions.

**My recommendation for a small business in Canada would be to start by comparing Wagepoint, QuickBooks Payroll, and ADP.** These are more relevant options for Canadian payroll than popular US-focused services like Gusto.

Here are the options I'd look at.

## Best payroll software in Canada

![Canada bank holidays and processing deadlines – Wagepoint](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/BeLrJTSa5EcYGruwCn3ZDIxMUlfcXvUOAWq-VkLCLOXdz1jzkCEyci0fWXdrXgftGn6W2rYz-lwC8Y0IoRwsfjD4UWeNALSFIPbehrCIgAbl20XbCFLJPYeU7ALSuo1T_gE3VKm0vx7ep4xL3fMx4B0KmoO2Sjhoyl0a8jBEmmu8q-IbjKKE4gQp0SBNRaHp?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Wagepoint**

(Best overall for small businesses)

- Designed specifically for Canadian payroll.
- Calculates CPP, EI and income tax.
- Handles CRA remittances, T4s and ROEs.
- Direct deposit and employee self-service.

Published starting price: approximately \$20 CAD/month plus per-employee fees, depending on plan.

[Wagepoint website](https://wagepoint.com/)

---

![Payroll Pricing & Features | Quickbooks Canada®](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/erX_DC1jZsLVxU1t89QoL1DvLk-jfYEM-TY5mlkC0JbhbZTu0BD1gTiyzm4TNVr1eMNloShBTvXHcIXIOD2wzsYuN3miIQI8PWMs_ljyCimOYYkJsMWqoNjRJoeEChC24eQmPYbOzMojoAXDu1R2hX9-12mpvT4S1B6AtCkfIba_3hbYHevadZ-Np-CdB7Sa?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. QuickBooks Payroll**

(Best for bookkeeping integration)

- Connects payroll directly to QuickBooks accounting.
- Calculates payroll deductions.
- Handles T4s, ROEs and CRA remittances.
- Convenient for businesses already using QuickBooks.

[QuickBooks Payroll website](https://quickbooks.intuit.com/ca/payroll/)

---

![ADP Mobile Solutions - Business App | MWM](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/FjKuwKbE7H1O6PUG8RQHLvOdYy_cnuXPh0rTZTs9jh-eTU9cjwM9XYd1_itM1qM3OvSkzConWpFFKB_oWcDw0HcXG-1--TREcRlRH89LXc2kgQpy2kL5rDAWhgCSDib-aIkMzKLpxrV9ouQuQechTBo89K3TRmmC3mEebUgPjT_j5WfAjbjS-NpgXe2nfbgF?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. ADP Canada**

(Best for growing businesses)

- Comprehensive payroll processing.
- HR and employee management tools.
- Compliance support.
- Suitable for larger teams and more complex payroll.

[ADP Canada website](https://www.adp.ca/)

---

![Payworks - Made In Canada Directory](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/JDMxoSeGQxMxiFL1WlmiX5yAKI9xRuaDUfQb6s6QcfAxTFJFbnN2kRi-gEYbnnOG4PrWAZTFpn3xs21LhDWxnQbK2WD_IFUqHaSdFe_RAXAGW3S0REiMzKGkkZ8KZy6JjkEu468uzREKIBJ8oxcvN3ufTsXg2JM7b6x4a2BhfAvpRoWj75NBPNUO2vBVAHLK?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Payworks**

- Canadian payroll provider.
- Good customer support options.
- Payroll, time tracking and HR services.
- Worth considering if you prefer more hands-on assistance.

[Payworks website](https://www.payworks.ca/)

---

![Why Choose Knit? | Knit People](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/oYUKDuElksuaE_SYAIIR0jB8n415ynaK0gAEtYo0FVGjD3O2BdOFBw73yB1G4Aiwd0VSAOMsySvBPFhbkuSrRCmBsbH0vFgTlR98YkJWyHexbLUeG9ccJeq5p3AYj5eVy32CEzcZkpGWAxsBfv62RSrqhjuMTtcNQbJfXS3ad-zBVKAhBKa4Z5DokIFDl7cV?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Knit**

- Combines payroll and basic HR.
- Employee onboarding and time-off management.
- Good option if you want more than just payroll.

[Knit website](https://knitpeople.com/)

search_results.description: The article reviews payroll platforms for small businesses in 2026, assessing features, pricing, usability, integrations, documentation, and customer support. Gusto is its top dependable choice, combining full-service payroll, tax compliance, benefits, and accounting integrations. Xero stands out for accounting and app integrations, while QuickBooks is recommended for mobile payroll. Paychex suits businesses seeking outsourced HR and benefits administration; Rippling offers flexible, scalable HR, payroll, IT, and expense tools. Remote Payroll supports international hiring and compliance, and Zoho People bundles payroll with a broad HR and business ecosystem. Other picks include PeopleHR for UK SMEs, Patriot Payroll for straightforward value, BambooHR for ease of use, Hourly for time tracking and workers’ compensation, 1st Money for small UK businesses (free for fewer than 10 employees), Breathe HR for simplified HR, and Employment Hero for advanced features. The article also highlights ADP’s payroll and HR services. It advises choosing software based on business size and required features, prioritizing compliance, integrations, transparent pricing, employee self-service, and responsive support.
